skills.name: mcpp-basics
skills.description: Install mcpp and create, build, and run a first C++ module project. Use focused skills for advanced configuration or integration protocols.
skills.chinese: 安装 mcpp，创建并运行首个模块项目

skills.name: mcpp-projects-and-templates
skills.description: Create mcpp projects with new and package-provided templates, list template names, and validate generated files.
skills.chinese: 创建工程、查找及实例化包模板

skills.name: mcpp-commands
skills.description: Find public mcpp commands and option ownership, distinguish global flags, and forward arguments without confusing product names with target triples.
skills.chinese: 查找命令、参数归属和参数透传方式

skills.name: mcpp-manifest
skills.description: Write and inspect mcpp.toml package identity, language standard, metadata, version floors, and configuration table ownership.
skills.chinese: 编写 manifest 基础信息并定位配置项

skills.name: mcpp-targets
skills.description: Configure mcpp product targets, library interfaces, executable entries, resources, exports, and platform-specific product properties.
skills.chinese: 定义产品目标、入口、库接口、资源和导出

skills.name: mcpp-cxx-modules
skills.description: Configure module source discovery, public exports, scan overrides, generated interfaces, and imports of wrapped C/C++ libraries in mcpp.
skills.chinese: 配置模块源、公开接口、扫描和生成接口

skills.name: mcpp-build-options
skills.description: Set mcpp build and profile options with correct package, usage, and graph scope, including dialect flags and workspace merge behavior.
skills.chinese: 设置构建选项、profile、作用域和合并规则

skills.name: mcpp-features
skills.description: Define and activate mcpp features, optional dependencies, feature forwarding and capability gates without confusing union semantics with backend selection.
skills.chinese: 定义和启用特性、可选依赖及能力门控

skills.name: mcpp-workspaces
skills.description: Configure mcpp workspace members, virtual roots, shared package/build/dependency layers, and member selection without leaking root-only settings.
skills.chinese: 配置工作空间成员、共享层和成员选择

skills.name: mcpp-build-and-run
skills.description: Build and run mcpp products with profiles, package and target selection, cache modes, runner options and argument forwarding.
skills.chinese: 构建并运行，选择 profile、成员、目标及 runner

skills.name: mcpp-tests
skills.description: Discover, select, build and run mcpp tests, configure test policy, export test launches or archives, and interpret failures and skipped capabilities.
skills.chinese: 发现、构建和运行测试，处理超时、能力及 launch

skills.name: mcpp-dependencies
skills.description: Manage mcpp source dependencies, exact selectors and version requirements, lockfiles, path/git sources, and runtime versus dev/build edges.
skills.chinese: 管理依赖来源、版本、锁文件及不同依赖图

skills.name: mcpp-indices
skills.description: Configure, inspect, update and pin mcpp package indices, distinguishing project registries from globally synchronized repositories.
skills.chinese: 配置、检查、更新和固定包索引

skills.name: mcpp-toolchains
skills.description: Inspect, install and choose mcpp toolchains with per-host and target overrides, local compiler paths, runtime constraints and provider diagnostics.
skills.chinese: 安装和选择工具链，处理目标覆盖及本地编译器

skills.name: mcpp-cross-compilation
skills.description: Build mcpp projects for another target triple or target set with correct host/target graphs, sysroot, conditional settings and execution expectations.
skills.chinese: 交叉构建并区分宿主、目标、sysroot 和运行能力

skills.name: mcpp-runtime
skills.description: Configure C/C++ runtime and dependency linkage in mcpp, deploy dynamic libraries, and distinguish loader search paths from public link requirements.
skills.chinese: 配置运行时、链接形态、动态库部署和搜索路径

skills.name: mcpp-external-tools
skills.description: Declare xlings tools and payloads for mcpp, apply local overrides, and resolve on-request tools without confusing installed payloads with host-built binaries.
skills.chinese: 声明外部工具、覆盖和按需 provision

skills.name: mcpp-build-programs
skills.description: Write mcpp build.mcpp configuration programs using the bundled public module, declared rerun inputs, diagnostics and phase-specific contracts.
skills.chinese: 编写构建程序并声明重跑、诊断和阶段限制

skills.name: mcpp-build-api
skills.description: Look up the actual bundled mcpp.core public C++ functions, action methods, diagnostics and build-program directive contracts; excludes internal engine modules.
skills.chinese: 查询公共 C++ API 签名和构建指令契约

skills.name: mcpp-build-actions
skills.description: Declare incremental mcpp actions with explicit argv, files, tools, depfiles and generated module identities using the source/check/object/artifact/prepare roles.
skills.chinese: 声明增量 action、工具输入、输出和 depfile

skills.name: mcpp-rule-packages
skills.description: Author and consume reusable mcpp rule modules, feature-gated device extensions and host-built tools, including explicit build-time reexports.
skills.chinese: 编写和消费规则包及宿主工具依赖

skills.name: mcpp-toolchain-providers
skills.description: Configure local or program-provided mcpp toolchains using bootstrap/configure phases, tool roles and explicit origins rather than hard-coded compiler layouts.
skills.chinese: 编写工具链配置与 bootstrap，声明工具角色

skills.name: mcpp-platform-packages
skills.description: Author and override mcpp platform packages with targets, ABI layers, tools, link contracts, runners, host settings and carriers.
skills.chinese: 编写平台包并配置层、工具、链接、runner 和 carrier

skills.name: mcpp-payloads-and-adapters
skills.description: Package prebuilt tools and libraries, runtime adapters, BSP contributions and custom distribution formats for mcpp consumers.
skills.chinese: 编写 payload、运行时适配、BSP 和分发格式扩展

skills.name: mcpp-packaging
skills.description: Package mcpp applications and libraries with explicit linkage, closure, format, target legs, compression, debug symbols and machine-readable artifact results.
skills.chinese: 打包应用和库，选择格式、闭包、目标及调试符号

skills.name: mcpp-publishing
skills.description: Prepare mcpp library releases and index descriptors, inspect xpkg and SBOM output, and validate source/prebuilt consumer interfaces before publication.
skills.chinese: 准备库发布、索引描述符、xpkg 和 SBOM

skills.name: mcpp-devices
skills.description: Reach non-native artifacts through mcpp runners, named device actions, launch descriptions, exclusive access and declared runtime files.
skills.chinese: 通过 runner 运行、调试或访问非本机产物

skills.name: mcpp-heterogeneous-builds
skills.description: Configure accelerator selections and rule-driven device languages in mcpp, preserving host/device ABI boundaries and honest backend validation.
skills.chinese: 配置异构后端、设备语言和 host/device 边界

skills.name: mcpp-freestanding
skills.description: Build bare-metal and freestanding mcpp targets using BSP-provided startup, ABI/runtime layers, link scripts and an actual execution runner.
skills.chinese: 构建裸机工程并声明启动、运行时和链接契约

skills.name: mcpp-machine-interface
skills.description: Drive mcpp from an agent or program with positive protocol detection, JSON/NDJSON, launch/result records, exit statuses, denied effects, locks and cancellation.
skills.chinese: 使用机器协议、launch、结果记录、退出状态及副作用约束

skills.name: mcpp-build-database
skills.description: Export mcpp S1 build databases and compile commands for editors or tools, watch declared inputs and distinguish read-only export from configure-only project writes.
skills.chinese: 导出构建数据库并处理 watch、fingerprint 和写入边界

skills.name: mcpp-environment
skills.description: Inspect mcpp home selection, configuration and environment, separate user and system maintenance, and avoid changing unrelated global installations.
skills.chinese: 检查 home、配置、环境及系统维护边界

skills.name: mcpp-cache
skills.description: Inspect and clean mcpp project outputs and shared dependency/std/tool caches with explicit scope, stale previews, verification and size or age budgets.
skills.chinese: 检查和清理工程输出及共享缓存

skills.name: mcpp-troubleshooting
skills.description: Diagnose mcpp failures through resolved decisions, structured diagnostics, environment checks and targeted reproduction instead of speculative cache deletion.
skills.chinese: 依据诊断、解析决策和最小复现排查问题
